correctness.rationale: Poisson Gram identity and parity regrouping give an exact continuous 2x2 Toeplitz symbol. Its algebraic inverse has constant positive diagonal and offdiagonal proportional to |cos(theta/2)|, forcing monotonic Gram-band endpoints. Matrix Toeplitz quotient identifies essential spectrum and weakly null test vectors show operator and inverse norms are sharp; singular filter t=+-1 handled separately. Finite checker corroborates only algebra/numerics.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The general symbol theorem requires deriving this particular exact symbol and solving its extremal eigenvalue problem; mere availability of a framework does not explicitly cover these sharp formulas. This remains the principal residual-risk comparison.

These answer a concrete, parameter-complete spectral question.
